label: Summer of Bitcoin
source: public/data/otherProjects.json (program "Summer of Bitcoin"), read from summerofbitcoin.org's project list, with each github.com link re-read via gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>
note: One row per funded Summer of Bitcoin project. `b` keeps the fellow's institution as the program's own record states it and `m` the mentor the program lists. 50 row(s) point at a GitHub repository that we then re-read through the GitHub API for stars, language, license, description and topics; 2 repository links no longer resolve and were dropped rather than shipped as dead links. Rows whose program record carries no repository keep the fields empty. Organizations are keyed by the project name the program's own list uses, and that name is not a GitHub account, so no `orgs` URL is filled.
